gaps.sentence: The security guard waved us ___ without checking our passes.
gaps.explanation: 'Wave somebody through' = signal them to pass a checkpoint.

gaps.sentence: The old buses are being phased ___ next year.
gaps.explanation: phase out = stop using something gradually.

gaps.sentence: Please carry ___ with your work; don't mind me.
gaps.explanation: carry on = continue; carry out = perform (a task).

gaps.sentence: I can't put up ___ this noise any longer.

gaps.explanation: pick up = learn without formal study; also collect (pick somebody up).

gaps.sentence: Several runners passed ___ in the heat.
These old boots are completely worn ___.
gaps.explanation: wear out = become thin/unusable through use.
